zh: 按规则，能兑换时一定优先兑换，而 P 只会在兑换时减少、不会被任何动作产生。所以兑换一共会发生多少次，只取决于初始 P 的数量。
兑换次数就是 floor(P/rate)。每次兑换本身算一个周期，并产生一个新的 A；所有 A（初始的和新产生的）最后都会被各消耗一次，每次也算一个周期。
数出串中 A 的个数 cntA 和 P 的个数 cntP，答案为 cntA+2·floor(cntP/rate)。不需要模拟过程。
en: By the rules a conversion always happens first when possible, and P only decreases during a conversion; no action ever creates a P. So the total number of conversions depends only on the initial count of P.
The number of conversions is floor(P / rate). Each conversion is one cycle and produces a new A; every A, initial or produced, is eventually consumed once, and each consumption is also one cycle.
Count the A's (cntA) and the P's (cntP) in the string; the answer is cntA + 2 * floor(cntP / rate). No simulation is needed.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Each conversion consumes a fixed number of P's, so floor(P/rate) conversions can be made. Every conversion also produces an A that must be consumed later, so the total number of cycles is the initial number of A's plus twice the number of conversions.

## Correctness

P only decreases, and only during a conversion; no other action produces a P, so the total number of conversions is fixed. Every A, initial or newly produced, is eventually consumed exactly once, so adding the two kinds of actions gives the number of cycles.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1).
